bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 再度破位

read.en: MP Materials fell 6% on Oct 12 to $43.36 on 1.5 times normal volume, below the Oct 1 low of $44.49. It sits under all its averages, from the 5 and 10-day ($46.1–46.3) to the 200-day ($56.5), and all of them are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and below zero, Parabolic SAR turned bearish again on Oct 12, and RSI is 35.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月12日以约 1.5 倍常量下跌 6%，收于 $43.36，跌破 10月1日低点 $44.49。股价位于全部均线下方，从 5 日和 10 日（$46.1–46.3）到 200 日（$56.5），且均线全部下行。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 于 10月12日再次转空，RSI 为 35。

read.en: With $44.5 broken, there is little support until $40 and then the 52-week low of $37.81 (Jul 29). The base attempt has failed for now. Resistance is $44.5, then the 5 and 10-day averages near $46.2 and the 30-day at $49.5 (the Oct 6 high of $48.65 sits just below).
read.zh: $44.5 失守后，下方直到 $40 都缺乏支撑，其次是 52 周低点 $37.81（7月29日）。筑底尝试暂告失败。阻力为 $44.5，其次约 $46.2 的 5 日和 10 日均线，以及 $49.5 的 30 日均线（10月6日高点 $48.65 位于其下方）。
